name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
summary: On Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle keeps a network of buzzboxes working from Auberdine. The eccentric gnome engineer lives upstairs at the inn, far from the halls of Gnomeregan and Ironforge.

sections.title: An Engineer in Auberdine
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle brings Alliance ingenuity to Auberdine. The gnome engineer works on the inn’s upper floor, among tools and spare parts. The night elves here seek harmony with nature and follow ancient customs. Wizbang turns instead to practical mechanical problems, far from the solemn druidic traditions of Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Buzzbox Network
sections.body: Along Darkshore’s rugged coast, Wizbang maintains a network of buzzboxes. His devices send automated reports and carry messages over long distances. Coastal weather and hostile wildlife often damage them. Wizbang asks travelers to find parts, salvage tools such as gaffer jacks, and recover electropellers so the network can keep working.

faq.q: Where can I find Wizbang Cranktoggle?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle lives on the upper floor of the inn in Auberdine, the night elf settlement in Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Wizbang Cranktoggle doing in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Wizbang is an Alliance engineer working to establish and maintain buzzboxes across the Darkshore wilderness.
Buzzboxes are Wizbang Cranktoggle’s mechanical devices for monitoring and sending information over long distances across Darkshore. Wildlife and harsh weather often damage them.

faq.q: Is Wizbang related to any other gnomes?
faq.answer: Wizbang shares a surname with Delber Cranktoggle, which suggests they may belong to the same family of tinkerers.

faq.q: Why do the night elves tolerate his tinkering in Auberdine?
faq.answer: The night elves and gnomes are members of the Grand Alliance. Auberdine offers lodging and refuge to allied races, though gnomish machines contrast with elven harmony with nature.

faq.q: What tasks does Wizbang give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Wizbang asks travelers to help repair and configure his buzzboxes by searching the shore for parts such as electropellers and gaffer jacks.

angles.text: As a gnome, seeing one of your people run an experimental communication network along Kalimdor’s rugged coast recalls Gnomeregan’s relentless inventiveness.
As an engineer, you can recognize the gnomish habit of solving logistical problems in uncharted lands with custom tools such as gaffer jacks and electropellers.
As a night elf, you know sentinels and druids rely on wisps, messengers, and bonds with nature. Wizbang brings loud, whirring gears and metal boxes into Darkshore’s sacred woods.
